metric.name: nrmse_inplane_per_step
metric.definition: for case c and step t: sqrt(mean over nodes and channels (u_x,u_y) of ((pred - stats_mean)/stats_std - (truth - stats_mean)/stats_std)^2); stats_mean/stats_std = test.stats_mean/test.stats_std of the FEM tensor (same normalisation as scripts/run_cmp3d_gate2.py::gate2_metrics nrmse_inplane)
metric.pooled_identity: sqrt(mean over (c,t) of curve[c,t]^2) == gate2_metrics nrmse_inplane
metric.aggregation: curve_mean = mean over test cases, curve_median = median over test cases, seed_mean = mean over seeds of the per-seed curves
metric.secondary: nrmse_3d_per_step (same, all three channels) and truth_rms_inplane_per_step (sqrt mean of the normalised truth, for reference only)

1.config: closed-form (scripts/cmp3d_dmdc_gate2.py, fix data, fix POD basis)

provenance.cuda_device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition
